2893-3875-6168-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

391-2645-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-2645-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1734-6132-8095.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1676-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

277-4365-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1486-2757-5929-6291.easyPrerequisites: There's a basic land on the battlefield.
1486-2757-5929-6291.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, which is a Dwarf due to Leyline of Transformation.
Magda triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

1274-2685-3263-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2685-3263-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1376-7175.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-7175.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-6965-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-6965-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-6965-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2506-3129-4836-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3446-3532-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3446-3532-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

104-2811-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2811-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

757-4644-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

891-2292-2961.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

573-1558-3129-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-3129-3875-4231.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

880-6763-7201.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1753-3899-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1651-1770-2573-3875-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-2573-3875-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-2573-3875-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

3147-3609-6099-6881.description:
Play Azorius Chancery. When it enters, it and Mossborn Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mossborn Hydra trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
3147-3609-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

1343-2686-6682.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Clever Concealment by paying at most {2}{W}{W}, phasing out Barren Glory until your next turn.
Cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, discarding your hand, and sacrificing all permanents, causing target player to lose 5 life.
At the beginning of your next draw step, Barren Glory phases in.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
1343-2686-6682.notes: You can use Clever Concealment's convoke ability to reduce its cost, if desired.

719-907-1399-1606.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

575-3944-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-3944-5971.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Yedora triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blood Pet by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Blood Pet face-up.
Repeat.

56-4054-5256-6112.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4054-5256-6112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-4054-5256-6112.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

813-914-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
813-914-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Scholar of the Ages.
When Dockside Extortionist and Scholar of the Ages enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
813-914-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

5033-5078-5243-5679.easyPrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
5033-5078-5243-5679.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
5033-5078-5243-5679.description:
Activate a land that enters the battlefield untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kellan triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

891-1585-2523-5256.easyPrerequisites: In Bolas's Clutches attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-1585-2523-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Boonweaver Giant's power.
Repeat.

1651-3129-5469.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating two Clue, Food or Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

1261-4618-4916.notablePrerequisites: Animate Artifact and Instill Energy attached to Time Vault.
1261-4618-4916.description:
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Time Vault.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2433-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2433-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite creature token.
Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Triskelavite tokens to Ashnod's Altar, and then sacrifice them to their own abilities to deal infinite damage.

3382-4089-4191-4600.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {0}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Barrin.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Barrin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Barrin by paying {0}.
When Barrin enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

317-1475-2034.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-2719-4783.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-2719-4783.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is one of your commanders.
2034-2719-4783.description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
Choose to have Sakashima enter the battlefield as a copy of Hellkite Courser.
Sakashima enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sakashima, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sakashima to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sakashima trigger from step 3, putting Sakashima from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1671-1772-4826.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2918-3575-4381.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing itself.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Aerie Ouphes ability, dealing damage equal to its power to Darksteel Gargoyle.
Repeat.
